NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Verify attendance at your assigned workplace and show your duty route.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: During active duty, share your work location with your authorized manager even when the screen is locked. Tracking stops at checkout.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Capture work photos and attendance evidence when you choose Take photo.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save a work photo to your photo library when explicitly requested.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Movement information can improve duty tracking efficiency if enabled in a future tracking configuration.
